tasks.design: Configure native job-to-approved-chart links in {OPS_SYSTEM} and {DOCS}. The operator verifies actual stock, determines all treatment parameters and captures/checks the final selection before a separate job-record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable approved chart can repeat manual navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native material/job links can narrow retrieval without selecting a treatment.
tasks.still_hard: Material condition, required properties and equipment limits need competent treatment judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The operator recognises stock or equipment conditions outside the approved recipe's applicability.
tasks.altitude: Less chart navigation; treatment selection stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native job/material links can retrieve approved heat-treatment references; this is not evidence that software safely determines a new treatment.

assumptions: Actual material/specification owners supply stock properties, hardness targets and approved recipes; operator verifies applicability and equipment limits. No properties are inferred from an unverified stock label.

Retained s3 determines every parameter; retained s4 captures the new selections and completely checks the final record. Actual job recording only where required; otherwise remove and reweight. No controller setting or furnace start is performed here; any such action needs its own exact-final-setting gate.

Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Native links first; existing recipe access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent and uses the existing final check without added approval work.
unknowns: Which chart navigation repeats beyond existing recipe selection?
research_questions: Does native job linking shorten retrieval after stock and applicability checks?

tasks.human_edge: The operator identifies when an apparently applicable chart cannot safely meet the actual part requirements.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: approved material/chart indexing can assist reference retrieval; it does not establish safe quenching parameters for unverified stock or equipment.

assumptions: Actual specification/material owners provide required properties and current approved charts; operator verifies stock and actual bath/media condition. No new measurement is assumed free.

S3 retains all treatment choices; s4 retains actual selected-value capture and full final checking. Actual record only if required. Shared stock/chart preparation with 12095 counted once in a combined job; task scenarios are alternatives, not additive savings.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native links first; existing chart access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using the existing final check. No bath adjustment or treatment actuation is included; actual actuation needs its own final-setting gate.

tasks.design: Keep immediate readiness assessment and the actual forklift signal with the operator. The final movement instruction is checked before its separate communication; no digital record or report is required by this signal-only branch.
tasks.previous_blocker: This task is immediate physical coordination rather than repeated document production.
tasks.enabler_now: No digital change is established for the actual signal-only work.
tasks.still_hard: Safe movement depends on live equipment, container, route and operator conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The operator can withhold or stop a signal when conditions change.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: immediate furnace-container signalling requires current physical readiness and understood communication; no labour saving is established here.

assumptions: Zero applies to actual signal-only work after examining lookup, record, report and send components. There is no required separately prepared digital instruction, record write or report in this branch; the actual signal is explicitly s3, not hidden inside physical checks.

If the actual site requires load lookup, movement record or written request, split its capture/check, gated commit/send and re-estimate before applying this zero. Existing displays do not eliminate live readiness checks; forklift operator labour and physical travel are excluded.

Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. S2 is existing final readiness/instruction checking, not added approval labour. Conditions changing invalidate its gate; repeat the actual check. No new software or upkeep proposed.
